title: Savills Commercial Property Scraper
description: Extract commercial properties for sale from Savills. Provide a Savills search URL, or provide a location with optional property, price, bedroom, currency, and sorting filters.

start_url.title: Savills Search URL
start_url.description: Optional complete Savills commercial property-for-sale search URL. Use this field or provide location and the filter fields below.

location.title: Location Path or Slug
location.description: Optional Savills location path, such as europe or england/london/london/ec3n. This replaces the location part of start_url. You can also provide a complete Savills search URL.

min_price.title: Minimum Price
min_price.description: Optional minimum asking price in the selected currency.

max_price.title: Maximum Price
max_price.description: Optional maximum asking price in the selected currency.

currency.title: Price Currency
currency.description: Optional three-letter currency code used for price filters and display, for example GBP, EUR, or USD.

bedrooms.title: Exact Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Optional exact number of commercial bedrooms when published by Savills.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of properties to extract.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for reliable scraping.
